_comment: Photos fetched from Wikimedia Commons by scripts/fetch-images.mjs.
Add an entry, run npm run fetch:images, and the file plus its credit row appear.
'commons' is the exact File: title on commons.wikimedia.org. The fetcher reads
the licence and author from the Commons API at fetch time and refuses anything
that is not public domain or a commercial-use Creative Commons licence.
One photo per entry and one use per photo: the fetcher rejects two entries
sharing a Commons source, and fails the build if any image is used twice.
Hand-added files are not listed here; see CREDITS.md for those.
